tools.name: get_shop_facts
tools.description: What roamflat is and how the Flat works, in the shop's own words: speeds, networks, when the days start, delivery, payment, refund policy, adding days, My Flat, e-mails, app, devices, support. Use for any question that is not a price.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Every country roamflat builds a Flat for, with the number of networks, whether 5G (and so 25/50 Mbps) is available, and the starting price per day (5 Mbps, cheapest network). Use to check coverage or compare countries.

tools.name: get_flats
tools.description: The networks of one country (operator, 5G) and the Flats built from them — each Flat with the networks it includes and the price for every speed for the given days (null = that speed needs a 5G network). Use to explain the choice between networks and speeds.

tools.name: quote_flat
tools.description: Use while the customer is still deciding — "how much is …?": the exact price of one configuration (country, speed, days and optionally which Flat / networks), the server price the customer would pay. Quote it as returned, never compute or scale it yourself. The result carries a buy_url for reference

tools.name: price_grid
tools.description: Prices for several speed × days combinations of one Flat in one call (up to 8 day values; speeds default to all), e.g. to compare with other providers or to find the best fit. Same server prices as quote_flat.

tools.name: recommend_config
tools.description: Use when the customer describes the trip instead of a speed: country (or up to 5), days and what will be connected (devices: phone, phone_laptop, small_group, family, creator_posting, creator_live, creator_hd_live, creator_pro). Picks the speed from the roamflat speed guide and returns it server-quo

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: A trip through several countries (max 5): one Flat per country, each quoted at the same speed and days unless given per country. days is PER COUNTRY, never the whole trip: for a 12-day trip through Japan and Thailand pass per_country days that add up to 12 (e.g. 7 + 5). Returns one line per country

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Use only once the customer has decided to buy ("I'll take it", "how do I buy?"): the checkout handoff. Returns the buy_url to give the customer, the final price and a ready-to-send checkout block (next_step, payment_methods, delivery) — on the page they press the buy button (buy_button, e.g. "Get yo

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_checkout · Public sink: start_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_checkout · Public sink: start_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
